q: How does a Nashik grape packhouse work out pre-cooling electricity per tonne?
title: Nashik grapes: pre-cooling per tonne
short: Multiply the pre-cooling and cold room kWh by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 and divide by tonnes packed in the same period. If the meter covers the whole packhouse, the figure includes packing too, so say so.
audience: Grape export packhouses and pre-cooling units in the Nashik cluster of Maharashtra

p: kWh for the pre-cooler and cold room, from the bill or a sub-meter.
Multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25.
Divide by tonnes packed for export.
Gas added during servicing is Scope 1 leakage. Multiply kg added by its GWP.

Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
